newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALBANIA, Durres - April 21 - 11 Vessels in port, all discharging, of which 4 wheat flour, 4 cement, 1 malt, 1 military aid cargo, 1 sugar. No vessels waiting in roads for berths.

BULGARIA, April 14-20 - Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik - 42 Vessels in port operating of which 22 loading (8 fertiliser, 7 soda, 2 scrap, 1 cigarettes, 1 npc, 1 kaolin/bentonite, 1 frozen chicken/general cargo, mo1lass). 12 Discharging (2 phosphorite, 1 wheat, 1 coke, 1 general cargo, 1 cars, 2 rice, 4 coal). 2 Discharging/loading trucks/containers, 6 discharging/loading containers. 9 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load (3 urea, 1 glass). 3 To discharge (2 rice, 1 coal), 2 cargo not nominated.

Bourgas - 21 Vessels in port operating of which 14 loading (4 metal, 4 fertiliser, 3 steel, 1 clinker, 1 flowers, 1 benzene). 6 Discharging (2 coal, 2 lead concentrate, 1 coke, 1 other). 1 Discharging/loading cars. 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load (1 equipment, 2 steel). 1 To discharge wheat, 2 unconfirmed. 19 Vessels due of which 13 to load (1 cable, 1 tobacco, 1 chemicals, 3 steel, 2 general cargo, 1 clinker, 1 zinc/timber, 1 bentonite, 1 metals, 1 other). 4 To discharge (1 cars, 1 coal, 1 copper concentrate, 1 iron ore). 2 To discharge/load containers.

April 21 - No labour problems. Varna - Varna east - Six vessels loading at berth, 1 waiting at anchor to load, 2 awaiting orders. Varna west - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load. Varna Lesport/Tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - Eight vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge. 4 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 18 due. Bourgas west - 5 Vessels loading at berth. Tanker port - 1 Vessel loading at berth.

CROATIA, April 21 - Pula - One vessel discharging at berth. Rijeka - Three vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading. 10 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 6 due, delays expected. Zadar - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 under repair/dry-docked. Split - Two vessels under repair/dry docked, 1 for sale. Dubrovnik - Two vessels awaiting orders. Rasa, Sibenik, Ploce - No vessels.

CYPRUS, April 22 - Limassol - Eight container vessels loading/discharging at berth, 3 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 13 Vessels due April 23 of which 5 containers, 2 conventional vessels, 5 passenger, 1 cruise vessel. Larnaca - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth. 3 Vessels due 23/4 of which 1 container, 2 conventional.

ESTONIA, April 21 - No labour problems. Tallinn - City port - 1 Timber vessel loading at berth, 1 map vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 1 liner vessel, 6 due. Kopli - 1 Sawn timber vessel loading at berth, 1 meat discharging, 10 due. Muuga - 7 Vessels loading at berth (2 general cargo, 2 fuel oil, 1 peat, 1 boards, 1 seeds). 5 Vessels discharging at berth (2 grain, 1 poultry, 2 general cargo), 5 due. No delays expected. Parnu - Nine vessels loading at berth (4 peat, 4 timber, 1 road-metal), 11 vessels due, no delays expected.

ITALY, April 22 - Genoa - Commercial port - 1 Vessel in roads, no delays, 28 berthed, 5 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - No vessels in road, no delays, 5 berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 5 berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 berthed, 4 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - Six vessels in roads, no delays, 40 berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona/Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta - Oil harbour no delays. Syracuse - Oil harbour - No delays. Sarroch - 12 In roads, 8 berthed. Taranto - Three in roads. Ravenna, Venice - No delays. Trieste - One in roads, minor delays at SIOT oil terminal.

LATVIA, April 22 - No strikes at any port. Riga - 19 Vessels in port of which 14 operating as follows - 5 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 2 tanker loaders, 2 steel loaders, 3 frozen food dischargers. 5 Vessels waiting, no delays, 23 due. Ventspils - Six vessels in port, all operating, of which 2 steel loaders, 1 butter discharger, 1 mop loader, 2 miscellaneous. 3 Waiting at outer anchorage. No delays, 11 due. Liepaja - Five vessels in port all operating, no delays, 4 due.

LITHUANIA, April 22 - Klaipeda - 16 Vessels operating of which 9 loading (1 packing materials, 3 fertiliser, 3 metal, 1 sunflower, 1 timber). 6 Discharging (5 fish, 1 sugar), 1 loading/discharging, No vessels in roads, 35 due.

POLAND, April 22 - Szczecin - 46 Vessels loading at berth, 35 discharging at berth. Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 vessels under repair/dry-docked, 79 vessels due. Gdynia - 10 Vessels operating of which 7 loading at berth (5 general cargo, 1 bulker, 1 other). 3 Discharging at berth (1 general cargo, 2 grain). 9 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 2 awaiting turn, 34 due. Gdansk - Nine vessels operating of which 6 loading at berth (2 bulkers, 3 general cargo, 1 coal). 3 Discharging at berth (1 tanker, 2 general cargo), 5 vessels under repair/dry-docked, 19 due.

PORTUGAL, April 21 - Leixoes - Eight vessels operating (5 general cargo, 3 containers), no vessels waiting. Vacant places, 8 piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes. Sines - Three vessels in port operating of which 1 discharging coal, 2 loading (1 propylene, 1 aromatic mixture). 1 Waiting to discharge coal, 8 due of which 2 to discharge (1 crude oil, 1 chemical naphtha), 6 to load (1 propylene, 1 ethylene, 1 propane, 1 gasoil/gasoline, 1 gasoil/jet fuel).

April 22, Lisbon - 69 Vessels in port of which 11 discharging at berth, 6 loading/discharging at berth, 1 loading at anchorage. 15 Under repair/dry-docked, 5 awaiting orders, 24 miscellaneous craft, 48 due. Setubal - Four vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 6 under repair/dry-docked. 10 Due of which 5 to discharge, 4 to load, 1 for repair/dry-dock.

ROMANIA, April 21 - Constanta - 34 Vessels operating of which 15 general cargo (12 loading, 3 discharging). 8 Bulkers (3 loading, 5 discharging), 5 bagged chemicals (4 loading, 1 discharging), 4 tankers (3 loading, 1 discharging), 2 loading cement. 6 Waiting in roads of which 2 general cargo, 2 tankers, 1 bagged chemicals (all to load), 1 bulker to discharge. Constanta south (Agigea) - 7 General cargo vessels (6 loading, 1 discharging). Mangalia - No vessels operating. Midia - Two livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA, April 22 - BALTIC PORTS - No strikes. Kaliningrad - Four vessels in port, all operating. No vessels waiting, no delays, 1 vessel due. Vyborg - Three vessels in port, all operating, no vessels waiting, no delays, 3 vessels due. St. Petersburg - 17 Vessels operating of which 8 loading (1 non-ferrous metal, 1 fertiliser, 3 containers, 1 scrap, 1 general cargo, 1 ply-wood). 9 Discharging (1 frozen fish, 1 containers, 1 powder, 1 milk powder, 2 frozen meat, 3 vegetables). 7 Vessels waiting, 9 due. Kaliningrad - Seven vessels operating, all loading, of which 3 non-ferrous metals, 1 containers, 1 coke, 1 ferro-alloys, 1 coal. 2 Waiting, 5 due.

FAR EASTERN ports, April 22 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok - 18 Vessels in port of which 7 loading (3 metal, 2 timber, 2 general cargo). 1 Discharging general cargo, 1 loading/discharging containers, 2 passenger, 7 waiting. Nakhodka - 11 Vessels in port of which 7 loading (3 metal, 4 timber), 4 waiting. Vostochny - Seven vessels in port of which 3 loading (1 timber, 1 coal, 1 scrap metal., 2 Discharging/loading containers, 2 waiting. Posyet - One loading aluminium. Zarubino - No vessels.

BLACK SEA, April 21 - Novorossiysk - 24 Vessels in port operating of which 15 loading (1 cement, 7 steel, 1 coal, 1 aluminium, 2 urea, 1 slabs, 1 carton/celluloid, 1 various). 9 Discharging (1 citrus, 2 rice, 3 oranges, 1 sugar, 2 various). 3 Waiting in roads of which 16 to load (2 scrap, 1 cast iron, 4 steel, 1 lead, 1 aluminium, 2 copper cathodes, 2 copper, 1 paper/scrap, 1 coal, 1 bulk saltpetre). 19 To discharge (10 sugar, 5 rice, 3 citrus, 1 baryte). 43 Due of which 33 to load (4 scrap, 1 cast iron, 15 steel, 3 aluminium, 2 zinc, 2 paper, 1 cellulose, 5 coal). 9 To discharge (4 sugar, 1 maize, 2 citrus, 1 barytes/flour, 1 equipment). 1 To discharge/load containers. Oil terminal - 3 Tankers berthed and loading of which 1 diesel oil, 2 crude oil. 4 Crude oil tankers waiting in roads, 10 crude oil tankers waiting to load. Oil terminal berths 2 and 3 closed for repairs from 6/5 for 23 days.

NORTHERN BASIN, April 22 - Murmansk - Five vessels operating of which 2 alumina, 1 cabotage, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 steel, 1 alumina discharger waiting for berth. 12 Vessels due during week of which 9 loaders (1 non-ferrous metals, 1 scrap, 2 cabotage, 4 apatite, 1 iron ore pellets). 3 dischargers (1 cabotage, 1 general cargo, 1 anode paste).

SLOVENIA, April 21 - Koper - 14 Vessels berthed of which 2 loading/discharging containers. 5 Loading (4 general cargo vessels loading sawn timber, steels, paper, 1 bulker loading coal). 7 Discharging (1 general cargo vessel discharging potatoes, 4 bulkers discharging chrome ore, alumina, soy, 1 tanker discharging gasoline, 1 reefer discharging bananas). 9 Vessels due next two days of which 2 containers to load/discharge, 1 car carrier to load, 3 car carriers to discharge, 1 livestock vessel to load bullocks, 1 bulker to discharge iron ore, 1 special tanker to discharge wine. No delays expected.

SPAIN, April 21 - Bilbao - 24 Vessels operating (2 tankers, 22 dry cargo), of which 13 discharging, 4 loading, 7 loading/discharging. No delays. April 22 - Aviles - Three vessels in port of which 1 loading steel products, 2 discharging (1 scrap, 1 alumina). Gijon - Four in port of which 2 loading (1 cement, 1 steel), 2 discharging (1 manganese ore, 1 dunite). No delays/congestion/strikes at either port. Cadiz - 14 In port operating of which 3 ro-ros, 2 cement, 1 flour, 1 iron, 1 ship building materials. 6 Under repair, no delays. Santander - Nine in port of which loading (1 malt, 1 sugar, 2 steel wire reels). 5 Discharging (1 wheat, 1 scrap, 1 fertiliser, 1 chemical products, 1 steel coils). No vessels anchored, no delays. Sagunto - April 23 - 21 Vessels operating of which 4 ro-ros loading/discharging general cargo. 13 Discharging (9 steel products, 2 fruit on pallets, 2 timber). 4 Loading (3 fertiliser, 1 general). No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf. No fog delays.

TURKEY, April 22 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 5 Vessels operating (2 containers, 2 dry-carg 1 ro-ro), no berthing delays. Galata - 3 Passenger vessels operating, no berthing delays. Ambarli - 8 Vessels operating, no berthing delays.

UKRAINE, April 21 - Mariupol - 11 Vessels loading at berth (6 metal products, 2 sulphur, 2 coal, 1 sun flower seeds). 1 Discharging at berth (containers). 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (1 fertiliser, 2 metal products, 1 clay, 2 coal). 1 Awaiting orders after discharging, 2 under repair/dry-docked. 12 Floating storehouses of which 10 fertiliser, 2 sulphur. 29 Vessels due of which 20 to load (10 metal products, 4 coal, 2 sulphur, 2 clay, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 fertiliser). 9 To discharge (1 sunflower seeds, 6 containers, 1 oranges, 1 fluorspar).

Kerch - Six vessels under repair/dry-docked, 1 due to load ore. Berdyansk - One vessel loading sunflower seed meal at berth, 1 due to load coal. Mariupol - 11 Vessels in port operating of which 10 loading (6 steel, 1 fertiliser, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 sulphur, 1 coal). 1 Loading/discharging containers, 6 waiting in roads, all to load, of which 1 fertiliser, 1 pig-iron, 1 fire-clay, 1 steel, 2 coal. 29 Vessels due of which 20 to load (8 steel, 4 coal, 1 pipes, 3 fertiliser, 2 fire-clay, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 ferrous metals). 3 To discharge (1 sunflower seeds, 1 citrus, 1 fluorspar). 5 To discharge/load containers, 1 cargo not nominated.

Odessa - 16 Vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (1 chemicals, 1 sunflower seeds, 2 metals, 1 oil, 1 steel). 1 Discharging citrus, 1 discharging/loading containers, 2 passenger vessels, 1 vessel waiting, 5 under repair. 5 Vessels in roads of which 3 to load (2 sunflower seeds, 1 steel), 1 passenger vessel, 1 waiting. 17 Vessels due of which 10 to load (6 metal, 2 urea, 1 seed-cake, 1 sunflower seeds). 1 To discharge sugar, 4 to discharge/load containers, 2 passenger vessels. Ilychevsk - 12 Vessels in port operating of which 10 loading (7 steel, 2 pig-iron, 1 paper), 2 to discharge/load containers. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load (1 chemicals, 1 scrap, 1 other). 2 To discharge/load containers. 13 Vessels due of which 4 to load (2 pig iron, 1 pipes, 1 steel). 2 To discharge spirit, 6 to discharge/load containers, 2 to discharge/load tires.

April 22 - Odessa - Steel cargoes (loading), 5 vessels berthed, 4 due. Containers, 2 vessels berthed, 3 due. Grain cargoes (loading), 2 vessels berthed, 2 anchored, 1 due. Tankers (loading), 2 vessels berthed. General cargo, 2 vessels berthed, 1 due. Fertiliser, 2 vessels due. Bulk sugar, 1 vessel due. Ilychevsk - Steel cargoes (loading), 6 vessels berthed. Containers, 2 vessels berthed.

YUGOSLAVIA, April 22 - Bar - Eight vessels berthed of which 4 discharging (3 bananas, 1 sodium sulphate). 4 Loading (2 steel coils, 1 acetic acid, 1 aluminium). 4 Ferries on the lines Bar-Bari-Bar, Bar-Koper-Bar, no delays. Zelenika (Bijela) - One vessel laid-up, 1 under repair, 1 on the line Kotor-Barletta-Kotor.
